definitions.gloss: numbered ticket; number tag; queue ticket
definitions.explanation: A small ticket, tag, or token with a number on it, used to manage waiting order at service counters, restaurants, government offices, and similar places. The customer takes a number and waits to be called.

examples.japanese: {番号札|ばんごうふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{番号札|ばんごうふだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{呼|よ}び→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will call you in the order of your ticket number.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{番号札|ばんごうふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧、30{分|ぷん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{待|ま}たされた。
examples.english: I took a number at city hall and was made to wait 30 minutes.

examples.japanese: {入口|いりぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{番号札|ばんごうふだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧{待合|まちあい}⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: A numbered ticket comes out of the machine at the entrance — please take it and wait in the waiting area.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧ (number) and ⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧ (tag, ticket, card). This is the standard term for the numbered tickets used in queuing systems throughout Japan — at banks, post offices, government counters, hospital reception desks, and many restaurants.

The system is ubiquitous in daily life in Japan. You typically take a {番号札|ばんごうふだ} from a machine or dispenser near the entrance, and then wait for your number to be displayed on a screen or called out by staff. Knowing this word is practical for navigating everyday errands.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {番号札|ばんごうふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take a numbered ticket
- {番号札|ばんごうふだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧: the order of ticket numbers
- {番号札|ばんごうふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: do you have a numbered ticket?

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{整理券|せいりけん}→整理券：08288_seiriken⟧: numbered ticket (for a queue or bus boarding order) — a near-synonym, often used on buses and at large events
- {受付番号|うけつけばんごう}: reception number — the number assigned at check-in, similar in function
- ⟦{引換券|ひきかえけん}→引換券：19009_hikikaeken⟧: exchange ticket, claim ticket — a ticket for picking up or exchanging something, different purpose
